'''2017 MPC Mark Sebring LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Sebring]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mark Sebring]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
